messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: opts_knit$set(width)
parts:
Hi

opts_knit$set(width=xx) works only when it is called before a call of
`knit(...)`.
Is this designed behavior?

here is a sample:

If I call

opts_knit$set(width=20) then it change the width.
without that it does not change.
options(width=...) works always as expected.


== test.Rmd
```{r}
library(knitr)
opts_knit$set(width=20) # not work
#options(width=20) # work
```

```{r}
options("width")
opts_knit$get("width")
summary(iris)
```

```{r}
opts_knit$set(width=100) # not work
#options(width=100) # work
```

```{r}
options("width")
opts_knit$get("width")
summary(iris)
```
==
